official_sources.title: Planning Data documentation
official_sources.authority: Department for Levelling Up Housing and Communities Planning Data

verified_contracts: entity endpoint supports json html and geojson
coordinate queries return intersecting entities for selected datasets
UPRN can be supplied through q and is more precise for registered properties
geometry_entity and geometry_relation support server-side spatial filtering
offset and limit paginate results and response links include next prev first and last
field and exclude_field control response fields
bulk downloads are available in CSV JSON GeoJSON where applicable and Parquet
large portfolios should use stable bulk snapshots rather than excessive API calls
absence of API results does not prove absence of constraints because coverage varies
API remains beta and production consumers must fail closed on unsupported assumptions
